title: Claude Councl
description: Claude is the world's most convincing yes man. Ask it if your idea is genius and it writes you a flawless argument for why it actually is. Ask it the same question the other direction, why is this a terrible idea? And it'll write you an equally flawless argument for why you should kill it. Now that's a problem. It means that you cannot actually trust Claude with your decisions. Until now. This is the Claude Council built by Ali Lehman and it's probably the smartest Claude skill that I've come across. So instead of Claude just agreeing with whichever angle that you push, you just say, ask the council and it spawns five AI advisors who each attack your question from a completely different side. The contrarian, it rips your idea apart looking for what's going to kill it. And the first principles advisor, it ignores your question entirely and it asks what you're actually trying to solve. The expansionist, it hunts for the upside that you cannot see. And the outsider, it gets none of your context. So it catches the oblivious stuff that you have stopped noticing. And then lastly, the executor only cares about what you actually do tomorrow morning. Now their answer is they all get scrambled and passed to five peer review agents. And finally, a chairman pulls it all together into just one verdict and one clear step. Now, every time I'm about to make a call, like, should I build this feature? Should I hire this person? What should I work on next? I just ask the council. Now, if you want the skill on your machine, comment need, and I'll send it over to you.
